statements.status_notes: CVE-2018-6951 is a NULL pointer dereference in intuit_diff_type() in src/pch.c of GNU patch through 2.7.6, reached with a mangled rename or copy patch that does not name two file names (https://savannah.gnu.org/bugs/?53132, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2018-6951). Upstream fixed it in https://git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/patch.git/commit/?id=f290f48a621867084884bfff87f8093c15195e6a (Fix segfault with mangled rename patch, February 2018), which requires both the old and the new file name to be present and valid before a rename or copy is attempted. That fix is in GNU patch 2.8: its ChangeLog carries the entry, and intuit_diff_type() in the shipped src/pch.c checks both names before printing "Cannot rename file without two valid file names" (https://sources.debian.org/src/patch/2.8-2/src/pch.c/). Debian rates the issue unimportant and lists 2.8-2 as vulnerable only because it records no fixed version. Every build of this package is built from upstream GNU patch 2.8, through Debian source package patch 2.8-2, and contains the fix. The fixed version is the lowest build in the package's current version scheme and the only one the DHI Debian repository now publishes; one older build from the retired version scheme sorts below it and so reads as affected, although it also contains the fix.
